items.description:
Why bike as a group? 🚲 It's proven to be safer as larger crowds increase visibility, it builds community among our neighbors, it demonstrates that the people of Spartanburg want to bike, and it's fun! 

We had the opportunity to partner up with @freewheelers_cycling and @palspartanburg to receive free bike valet and bonus food & drink tickets for @hhporchfest and we jumped at the opportunity! We're so glad you all joined us and we hope to have many more rides in the future 🌼

items.title: Hampton Heights is one of our beautiful historic neighborhoods. It's also a great example of a neighborhood that has sin...
items.description:
Hampton Heights is one of our beautiful historic neighborhoods. It's also a great example of a neighborhood that has single family housing sitting right next to a sixplex. 

Unfortunately right now building this exact thing wouldn't be legal or allowed by our zoning. But it doesn't have to be like that! We can update our zoning to allow the type of development that leads to these neighborhoods 🏡
